details:
This may come as a distast for some, even the devs, but vrchat missing a lot of its promised features

As such I'm here to request that an update be put to these instead of other things like monitizing avatars in game

List of missing Feature promised:

- PC/Android being the same

  - Adding audio to quest (this should already be a thing)

  - Limiting PC upload on both avatar and world while upgrading Android as it was stated would happen , Or removing android limit all together (honestly bad idea to unlock android and should go with the first, If you limit PC more players can join and in turn more avatar creator will know the standard as well)

  - Alowing of set shaders on android so they can use anything but lite and toon, and working with the shader if needed instead of saying it not possable

- Replacing EAC with somthing less lagging for most running something in the background, As I can run the game with nothing open in VR at 140ish but open a single app, say OBS and it dies to like 45-50 that a good 60% drop do to EAC!

(and don't say people need better computers, the min secs for this game, for VR on the site are half what im using so imagine someone not knowing what going on and looking at steam Min spec made for desktop!)

- Adding flat avatar serch, reasoning for not doing that removes use avatar worlds, but honestly this new update does that way worse so there no reason to not just add it

- Video player fix on PC avatars (quest if above is done)

- Re add bots that Removed malus/dup worlds and avatars, this should be clear, and i get why they the game no longer checked for malus do to the change in upload, BUT we all know that that did nothing. Readding the checks for dup worlds and maslus ones would save both save vrchat space (if its even needed) and players worry the world gana crash them by going in it. Yes it won't be perfect but more (and less lazy) is better

(To Be very clear when i mean Dup i mean copy paste worlds that were spammed within an hour or so like 7 bar worlds that look exactly the same for example)

I'm sure there more things im missing for missed problems promised and unsolved but others can add to this if you know of anything else or mark something as done if it get fixed somehow
title: Fixed Old Problems
